body.name: Active-pair weighted selective randomization test
body.construction: For \(C=C_n(\rho)\) and active \(j=(C,s)\in J\) with \(C_s=1\), reject when \(T_j(\theta_j)\) exceeds the upper \(\alpha\)-critical value under \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,C}\), the data-dependent chronological Fisher reference supported exactly on \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\).
